## What managing Gold Coast takes.

### Landmark addresses
From the Astor Street District's rowhouses to the East Lake Shore Drive Historic District's grand facades, exterior work here routinely runs through Chicago landmark review. We manage the approvals path alongside the contractors.

### Pre-war building systems
Steam heat, original elevator cabs, and hand-laid masonry demand engineers and specialty trades who know pre-war buildings. We maintain those vendor relationships and plan facade critical examinations years in advance.

### Full front-of-house operations
Many Gold Coast buildings run door staff around the clock. We coordinate staffing, scheduling, and payroll administration while protecting the service culture residents of these addresses expect.

## Gold Coast boards ask us first.

### Does CenterPoint manage landmark and vintage buildings in the Gold Coast?
Yes. We manage vintage condominium associations where exterior alterations require Commission on Chicago Landmarks review, coordinating approvals, specialty masons, and phased capital plans that respect both the architecture and the budget.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Gold Coast?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Gold Coast, Chicago (ZIP 60610, 60611). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Gold Coast?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Gold Coast association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access. Call [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652) or [request a proposal](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/contact).

### How should a Gold Coast board compare management companies?
Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois community association management firm license, a licensed manager, a flat monthly fee in writing, after-hours emergency coverage, and a written transition plan. Our free [proposal scorecard](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/tools/compare-management-proposals) helps boards score proposals side by side.
